description: [Data utilities] Verify a citation or DOI, or find research papers on a topic. Use when an agent must check that a reference exists and is cited correctly. Price: $0.005 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/paper-lookup

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

type.description: Crossref type, e.g. journal-article, book-chapter, posted-content

name: paper_lookup
title: Research Paper & DOI Lookup (Crossref) ($0.005)
